title: ⚡ 3-Day Fast-Track Sprint (PRS + IRS)
description: Accelerated 3-day dependency-grouped curriculum synthesizing Classical ML, Probabilistic Reasoning, Signal Transformations, Deep Learning, Symbolic Rules, and Comprehensive A+ Exam Simulations.

modules.title: Day 1: Classical ML + Probability + Search
modules.subtitle: k-NN, Naive Bayes (Laplace), SVM (Dual & KKT), PCA vs LDA (Rayleigh), K-Means/GMM-EM/Ward, A* & BBNs
modules.duration: 5–6 Hours (7 Levels + 6 Interactive Studios + Quizzes + 6 Structured Exam Questions)

modules.title: Day 2: Signal Processing + Deep Learning
modules.subtitle: Nyquist Aliasing, arPLS Drift, DTW, 2D Wavelets & STFT, CNNs (Receptive Field, Dilated, ResNet, GAP), LSTM CEC & Generative VAEs
modules.duration: 5–6 Hours (7 Levels + 6 Interactive Studios + Quizzes + 6 Structured Exam Questions)

modules.title: Day 3: Reasoning Systems + Integration + Exams
modules.subtitle: Rule Engines & Daemons, Cognitive Models (11 Entities / ACT-R), Attention & TransE, GAs (OX), Ensembles (Bagging/RF Variance, AdaBoost, Stacking), Multimodal RVM & Nov 2026 Crucible
modules.duration: 5–6 Hours (7 Levels + 6 Interactive Studios + 20 Grand Quizzes + 6 Structured Exam Questions)
